name: Scared Rider Xechs
original_name: スカーレッドライダーゼクス
source:
Troops of otherworldly aliens are invading earth. To protect the planet and humanity, six chosen youths are recruited into the Scared Rider team under you, their commander.

Gameplay is split into the adventure part and the battle part. Peer into the boys' everyday lives and get to know them better during their free time and send them to fight when the siren calls. The game comprises of 13 episodes, at the end of the day, will you be united with the man of your dreams or will you perish with the rest of the world?

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-43-49-en-70-3s7c.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
异世界外星军团正在入侵地球。为了保护星球与人类，六名被选中的青年加入Scared Rider小队，而你就是他们的指挥官。

游戏分为冒险与战斗两部分。闲暇时观察少年们的日常生活、进一步了解他们；警报响起时则派他们出战。全作由13章组成。最终，你会与梦中情人走到一起，还是与整个世界一同毁灭？

[摘自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-43-49-en-70-3s7c.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
